context_for_next_testing_agent: Virtual Meeting Integration is fully working. When Event Mode is Virtual/Online or Hybrid, Meeting Platform dropdown appears with 3 options: Zoom (disabled with 'Not configured' badge), Google Meet (disabled with 'Not configured' badge), and Other (Enter URL manually). The /api/meetings/status endpoint returns {zoom: false, googleMeet: false} since no credentials are configured. Manual URL entry via 'Other' option works correctly and saves meeting_url to database. Database columns added: meeting_platform, meeting_id, meeting_password, meeting_provider_payload.
